missing: The near-miss catcher misses real failures because it reads results that agentBuild has already cut to 300 characters (steps.push stores result: out.slice(0, 300), and nearMissesOf runs on those steps). Reproduced through the real agentBuild loop with a scripted model: a build of 21 ok nodes followed by a node that fails ('div failed: divided by zero') logs no near miss for that node (only the failed tool call is logged). runLines prints every node, up to 40 lines, so any board of more than about 5 to 15 nodes (the engine, car and house boards this app exists for) loses node failures after the first 300 characters, and refusals past them. NEAR-MISS.md and the NearMiss comment say the AI 'catches its own on each run ... a tool or a node that failed'. The unit test passes only because its fixtures are one short line. The fix is to read the untruncated result, or to keep failure lines apart from the stored text, and to add a test with a long result.

Nothing guards that the page shows the near misses, or that the eval runners print them: removing the whole display from view/nodes.ts left tsc and the whole suite green. That display is how the earlier failure 'nothing read the near misses' was mended, and it is untested.
